PORT MORESBY, TUESDAY, 2nd FEBRUARY

[2021

National Information and Communications Technology Act 2009

APPOINTMENT OF NICTA INSPECTORS

I, Kila Gulo-Vui, Chief Executive Officer of the National Information and Communications Technology Authority,
also known as “NICTA”, by virtue of the powers conferred by Section 283 of the National Information and
Communications Technology Act 2009 and all other powers me enabling, hereby revoke previous appointments of
the National Gazette No. G623 dated 26th September, 2018 and appoint the following persons to be NICTA
Inspectors to supersede all previous names and lists published, effective on the date of publication in the National

Gazette.
